veranderings.voor: paaie en ou geboue om jou
veranderings.na: paaie en ou geboue rondom jou
veranderings.rede: 'Rondom jou' is the natural way to say 'around you'; 'om jou' alone reads clipped.
An event takes 'waarop' (op 'n feesviering), not the locative 'waar' calqued on English 'where'.
An occasion takes 'waarop' (op 'n geleentheid), not the locative 'waar'; reviewer may route this definition to the writer.
